Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is benig recorded for claim purposes. Can you please
state your full name for the record?
A: I'd rather just go by the claimant on this one, if that's okay. I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you walk me through what happened at the intersection in League City?
A: I was making a left turn off the main road into the shopping center. I had my turn signal on and I was waiting for a
gap in oncoimng traffic. When I saw a clear spot, I started to turn, and that's when another car came through and hit
the front passenger side of my vehicle.
Q: Had the oncoming vehcile been stopped at the light, or was it moving at the time?
A: It was moving. It wasn't speeding that I could tell, but it didn't look like it slowed down much either.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you started your turn?
A: I saw headlights a ways back. I thought I had enough time, and I misjudged it. I'll own that part.
Q: How are you feeling now? Have you been seen by a medical provider?
A: My right shoulder is pretty bad. It hit the door frame when the airbag went off. I went to an urgent care clinic that
same day and they took X-rays. I've got a follow-up with an orthopedic doctor next week because the pain hasn't
gone away and I can barely lift my arm above my head.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?
A: Just that I'm cooperating fully and I have the photos I took at the scene. I can send them over whenever you need.
Q: Thank you for your time. We'll be in touch with next steps.
</page>

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
